about.title: A locally owned agency that has met the insurance needs of Texans.
text: Texas Statewide Insurance has met the insurance needs of Texans, writing both personal and business policies. The office is in Crosby and the coverage reaches across the state.

We are locally owned and operated and take great pride in the excellent service we provide our clients. Our rates are highly competitive, and we offer the highest quality protection and always give friendly and courteous assistance.

Our personal insurance lines include auto insurance, homeowner's insurance, boat insurance, motorcycle insurance, condominium insurance, renter's insurance and RV and motor home coverages. We represent many different insurance companies so that we can compare plans and find you the best value for your individual needs.
We specialize in business and commercial insurance needs covered with Business Owners Policies, General Liability, Workers Compensation and Commercial Auto and Truck.

faqs.q: What kinds of insurance do you write?
faqs.a: Auto and car insurance, homeowners insurance, life insurance, renters insurance, windstorm insurance and business and commercial insurance for all of Texas.

faqs.q: Do you only quote one insurance company?
faqs.a: No. We represent many different insurance companies so that we can compare plans and find you the best value for your individual needs.

faqs.q: What is in your personal insurance lines?
faqs.a: Auto insurance, homeowner's insurance, boat insurance, motorcycle insurance, condominium insurance, renter's insurance and RV and motor home coverages.

faqs.q: What does a renters' policy leave out?
faqs.a: It provides some of the benefits of homeowners' insurance, but does not include coverage for the dwelling, or structure, with the exception of small alterations that a tenant makes to the structure.
Do not be caught without windstorm insurance coverage. Our knowledge and experience allow us to help create the windstorm coverage you need while keeping the cost down.

faqs.q: What does commercial insurance cover here?
faqs.a: We specialize in business and commercial insurance needs covered with Business Owners Policies, General Liability, Workers Compensation and Commercial Auto and Truck, taking in property, general and professional exposures.

faqs.q: How do I ask for a quote?
faqs.a: Send your name, email and phone and tick the lines you want priced: Auto, Life, Home, Renters, Windstorm or Commercial. You can call the office on (281) 328-9000 during business hours instead.

facts.heading: Asking for a quote
facts.text: The quote request takes your name, email and phone and the lines you want priced: Auto, Life, Home, Renters, Windstorm or Commercial. You can add a subject and a message, and there is an option to subscribe to the newsletter.

facts.text: The office is on (281) 328-9000 and the fax is 832-201-9331. Email reaches us at charles@texasstatewide.com, and the office is open Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM.
